subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should this issue stay open for a narrow local-avatar failure diagnostic fix, be folded into the broader remote-avatar contract thread, or be closed after maintainers dispose of the open fork PR?
rationale: The remaining behavior affects local file-serving diagnostics and avatar security boundaries, while a conflicting open fork PR still claims to close this issue; automation should not silently choose the product/security contract or PR disposition.

options.title: Keep local diagnostic work here
options.body: Preserve the current local avatar route and add user-facing feedback for `too_large`, missing, and unsafe local avatar states, then close or reject the stale fork PR separately.

options.title: Fold into the remote-avatar issue
options.body: Move only the local oversized-avatar evidence into `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201` if maintainers want one avatar-contract thread for both local diagnostics and remote policy.

options.title: Accept current behavior
options.body: Document the 2 MB cap and machine-readable metadata as sufficient, close this issue, and explicitly close the open fork PR as not planned.

recommendation.title: Keep local diagnostic work here
recommendation.body: Preserve the current local avatar route and add user-facing feedback for `too_large`, missing, and unsafe local avatar states, then close or reject the stale fork PR separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history on the avatar resolver, gateway route, size limit, and Control UI avatar hardening that constrain the decision.
